claims.statement: No finite absolute C gives Phi(fg)<=Phi(f)+Phi(g)+C(Inf_x(f)+Inf_x(g)) for all Boolean factors sharing only x.
claims.quantifiers: For every finite C and every r>=1, all sufficiently large odd n in the explicit majority/one-point-gate family violate the inequality.

claims.statement: For Boolean factors sharing only x with independent private variables, Inf_x(FG)=p+q-2pq.
Controls-first and x-first expose different intermediate singleton balances, while the final signed potential telescope is identical and ends at Phi(K_n).
